tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. Warm, never pure white, so white cards and the white document sheet lift off it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, side panels, the app bar, list rows.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells set into a surface: search and text inputs, the timer tray, code.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: dividers between list rows and sections, card outlines. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: ghost buttons, inputs, icon buttons. 3:1 or better on paper, surface and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper, surface, surface-sunk and sun-soft (14:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, helper lines and examples on paper, surface, surface-sunk and sun-soft (5.9:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Fill for the mic button, the mark, the active-app dot and highlights. In Day it is only 1.9:1 on paper, so a sun fill always carries an on-sun glyph or label and never marks state alone. Never text on paper in Day — use sun-text.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for the step being dictated, the mic's resting halo and selected rows. ink, ink-muted and sun-text all read on it.

tokens.name: sun-text
tokens.usage: Amber as text: the Listening tag, per-use prices, active step numbers. On paper, surface and sun-soft (5.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Glyphs and labels on a sun fill — dark in both themes (8.7:1 and 9.6:1).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill — the one thing the screen is for. An alias of ink, so the sun stays free for the voice moment.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action fill (17:1 Day, 15:1 Dusk).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Links, the focus ring and information. Carried over from the clinic app's blue. As text on paper, surface, surface-sunk and sky-soft (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for an information pill or note, behind sky text.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: Recording in progress and destructive actions. Always paired with a word (Recording, Stop, Delete). As text on paper, surface and record-soft (4.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: record-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a Recording pill or an error note, behind record text.

tokens.name: on-record
tokens.usage: Glyph and label on a record fill (the mic while recording).

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Done, saved, synced, ready. Always paired with a word. As text on paper, surface and leaf-soft (5:1 or better).

tokens.name: leaf-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a Saved or Ready pill, behind leaf text.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The document sheet (prescription, discharge summary, letter). White in both themes, because it is what prints and what the PDF looks like.

tokens.name: sheet-ink
tokens.usage: Text and the letterhead rule on sheet, in both themes (17:1).

tokens.name: sheet-muted
tokens.usage: Field labels, column heads and 'Not dictated yet' on sheet (7:1).

tokens.name: sheet-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections on sheet.

tokens.name: sheet-active
tokens.usage: Tint of the sheet section being dictated right now, inside a 2px sun ring.

tokens.name: sheet-accent
tokens.usage: Amber text on sheet and sheet-active: the Listening tag (6.6:1 on sheet, 6.2:1 on sheet-active). Fixed in both themes because the sheet is always white.

families.sans: "Figtree", "Noto Sans Tamil", "Noto Sans Telugu", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: landing and empty-suite moments.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles and the running dictation timer (set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for the timer).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card headings and the main prompt in a card.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fever with chills for 3 days. Known diabetic.
styles.usage: Default reading text, dictated content, list text.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names, the spoken command in a guide, button labels at the large size.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Helper lines, secondary card text, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section and card labels. Set in capitals (text-transform: uppercase); write the source text in sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row metadata, tags, pill text. Never smaller than 12px.

styles.name: paper-title
styles.usage: The document's title on sheet, in capitals. The only serif on a screen: it marks 'this is the paper'.

styles.name: paper-letterhead
styles.usage: The sender's name in a letterhead on sheet.

spacing.note: A 4px base. The step names are multiples of 4px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; icon to text inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row of pills or tags; icon to label in a button.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; padding of a list row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of a side panel; gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter on tablet and desktop; gap between the main columns.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: App bar side padding; padding of a large card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of the document sheet; space before a new page section.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Side padding of the document sheet (its print margin on screen).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above and below a display headline.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: List rows, guide steps, tags, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons, the logo tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, side panels and the document sheet.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: App tiles in the suite launcher and the app icon.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and the round mic button.

shadow.note: Lightday separates with borders first. Shadows are for the sheet (it is paper on a desk) and the mic's halo.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The document sheet only.

tokens.name: halo-sun
tokens.usage: The mic button at rest: an 8px sun-soft ring.

tokens.name: halo-record
tokens.usage: The mic button while recording.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in paper, then a solid 2px sky ring (6:1 or better on every ground).

size.note: Hit areas. Lightday is used one-handed, between patients, on a phone.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area for anything tappable (icon buttons).

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a list row.

tokens.name: mic
tokens.usage: Diameter of the mic button.
